SRC-160:R001.text: [CORE-001 P1] Malformed nested persistence must fail closed instead of normalizing to defaults: zaicodeAgentRepo.rowToDefinition (tool_policy_json, model_selection) and zaicodeJobRepo.rowToJob (delegation_json, actual_model_selection) currently turn unparsable JSON into undefined/{} before outer validation, so a damaged restrictive tool policy silently becomes the unrestricted yolo default.
